mapper.sql: rp.id, rp.role_id, rp.privilege_key, rp.update_time, rp.create_time, rp.is_valid
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM t_privilege_info p left JOIN t_role_privilege rp on p.key = rp.privilege_key WHERE rp.is_valid =1 and rp.role_id = #{roleId} and p.is_valid =1 order by p.sort asc

SELECT p.* FROM t_privilege_info p left JOIN t_role_privilege rp on p.key = rp.privilege_key WHERE rp.is_valid =1 and rp.role_id = #{roleId} and p.is_valid =1 and p.menu_source='JWPC' order by p.sort asc

SELECT distinct t.privilege_key FROM t_role_user r, t_role_privilege t, t_base_user u WHERE r.user_id = u.id AND r.role_id = t.role_id AND u.id = #{userId} and u.is_valid = 1 and t.is_valid = 1 and r.is_valid = 1
